[LFAC.1.7.7] The declared-key identity model applies to a `logical`
base whether or not the `ambient` modifier is layered ([LSCP.2.5]):
`scope logical ambient` is `scope logical` for identity — same
require-all markers, same `key = all` ⇒ relation ([LFAC.1.7.2]).
`ambient` changes *who may write*, never *how the fact is keyed*.
